candidates: Remove unreachable code — in particular, statements placed after a `switch` block in which every branch already returns. Biome (configured in this project) reports these as `lint/correctness/noUnreachable` errors; resolve them before merging.

When refactoring changes a previously-computed value into a passed-in parameter, remove any `performance.now()` timing measurements that were specifically capturing that computation. Leaving them in place causes `logger.verbose` timing logs to always report near-zero durations, which misleads future readers about actual performance.

Keep `test()`/`it()` description strings in sync with the current name of the function or export under test, especially after renames; a stale name in a test title obscures what the test actually covers.

When a Storybook preset property function (`PresetPropertyFn` implementation) contains multiple distinct logical steps, extract each step into a named helper function to keep the preset body short, declarative, and easy to scan at a glance.
